title: Automated Defect Detection and Localization in Photovoltaic Cells Using Semantic Segmentation of Electroluminescence Images
mechanism: UCF-EL: large polygon-mask EL dataset (crack region, contact, interconnect, corrosion) with a U-Net baseline.
adaptation: Joint training: shared U-Net++ with a second 1x1 head for UCF-EL classes, loss only on each dataset's own labels, alternating batches; keeps UCF knowledge instead of the pretrain-then-erase run.
min_experiment: Arm joint training vs house, 5 seeds; crack IoU, E1 crack recall; kill if both within noise.
evidence: R: crack recall 0.82 and gridline/contact recall 0.78 (as quoted by Pratt 2023); heavy train/test leakage (BRIEF E).
prior_overlap: UCF-EL encoder pretraining with house fine-tune (erased) was n.d./worse; joint training never tried. Open.
